closed_r2_p0.closure: All root PASS artifacts remain under the hidden PID work root until post-generation input, attempt, cgroup, and seal checks pass; one same-filesystem mv -T then publishes the complete canonical directory.

closed_r2_p1.closure: The attempt has exactly two payload members plus SHA256SUMS and its outer seal, and is reverified after each point and at final boundaries.
Attempt staging uses same-filesystem mv -T and exact canonical-root population verification.

p1.finding: m485_complete is set before final mv -T, so an ordinary rename failure leaves an unquarantined hidden work root.
p1.impact: Cleanup and forensic organization only; canonical remains absent, exit is nonzero, and attempt remains consumed.
p1.recommended_repair: Use a publish_started state or a trap branch that quarantines the work root if final rename fails.

sigkill_boundary.preflight: temporary directory may remain; canonical and attempt absent
sigkill_boundary.pre_attempt_work: hidden work may remain; canonical and attempt absent
sigkill_boundary.post_attempt_pre_dc: attempt consumed and hidden work may remain; canonical absent
sigkill_boundary.during_dc: attempt consumed and hidden partial work may remain; canonical absent
sigkill_boundary.post_gates_pre_publish: attempt consumed and sealed hidden work may remain; canonical absent
sigkill_boundary.publish: atomic outcome is either hidden work or fully checked canonical directory
